opening: My symptoms get worse when I lie down and better when I sit up.
I'm quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe.
I get palpitations; my heart races or beats irregularly.
I've had a viral infection recently.

opening.text: I'm quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe. My symptoms get worse when I lie down and better when I sit up. I get palpitations; my heart races or beats irregularly. I've had a viral infection recently, and I've had pericarditis before.
